title: Tez nutqni tushunish: haqiqiy suhbatdagi ingliz tili
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz tez nutqdagi kuchsiz shakllar va qisqarishlarni (gonna, wanna, can/can’t) eshitib taniysiz, to‘ldiruvchi so‘zlar va o‘zini tuzatishlar orasidan yakuniy ma’lumotni ajratasiz, notanish iborani kontekstdan taxmin qilasiz va bir daqiqalik telefon xabaridan kamida beshta kalit ma’lumotni yozib olasiz.

scenes.title: Haqiqiy nutq — darslikdagidek emas
board: Understanding fast natural speech
(Tez tabiiy nutqni tushunish)
sounds · fillers · context · key words
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda grant arizasi va motivatsion xat yozdik. Bugun tinglashga o‘tamiz. Ko‘pchilik aytadi: “Darslikni tushunaman, lekin Zoom yig‘ilishida hamma juda tez gapiradi.” Muammo bilimda emas, quloq o‘rgangan shaklda. Bugun to‘rt qurol olamiz: tovushlar, to‘ldiruvchi so‘zlar, kontekstdan taxmin va kalit so‘zlar. Dars oxirida telefon xabaridan eng muhim ma’lumotlarni yozib ola olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Last time you wrote a motivation letter. Today we listen. Real people speak fast, swallow sounds and change their minds. Let's learn to follow them.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan safar motivatsion xat yozdingiz. Bugun tinglaymiz. Haqiqiy odamlar tez gapiradi, tovushlarni yutadi va fikrini o‘zgartiradi. Keling, ularni tushunishni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Kuchsiz shakllar (weak forms)
board: to /tə/ · for /fə/ · of /əv/ · and /ən/
can /kən/ · at /ət/ · was /wəz/ · them /ðəm/
End of sentence = strong: Who's it for? /fɔː/

examples.t: I've got a meeting at ten.

scenes.say_native: Grammatik so‘zlar, ya’ni predlog, yordamchi fe’l va olmoshlar odatda urg‘usiz aytiladi, unlisi qisqa “ə” ga aylanadi: “to” “tə”, “for” “fə”, “can” “kən”. O‘zbek tilida bunday kuchli qisqarish yo‘q, shuning uchun biz ularni to‘liq eshitishni kutamiz. Bitta istisno: predlog gap oxirida kelsa, u kuchli aytiladi: “What are you looking for?”
scenes.say: A cup of tea. I've got a meeting at ten. Can you send it to Sarah? She was late. But at the end: Who's this report for?
scenes.say_uz: Bir piyola choy. Soat o‘nda yig‘ilishim bor. Uni Saraga yubora olasizmi? U kechikdi. Lekin oxirida: Bu hisobot kim uchun?

scenes.title: So‘zlarni ulash (linking)
board: consonant + vowel: turn it off → tur-ni-toff
British linking r: four o'clock, after all
go on → go(w)on · I am → I(y)am
scenes.say_native: Undosh bilan tugagan so‘zdan keyin unli bilan boshlangan so‘z kelsa, ular ulanadi: “turn it off” go‘yo “tur-ni-toff”. Britaniya talaffuzida yozuvdagi “r” odatda aytilmaydi, lekin keyin unli kelsa qaytadi: “four o’clock”. Ikki unli orasida yengil “w” yoki “y” paydo bo‘ladi: “go on”, “I am”. Shuning uchun quloq so‘z chegarasini topa olmaydi.
scenes.say: Turn it off. Pick it up. Check it out. We'll start at four o'clock. After all, it's not a problem. Go on, I am listening.
scenes.say_uz: Uni o‘chiring. Uni olib keting. Buni ko‘rib chiqing. Soat to‘rtda boshlaymiz. Axir bu muammo emas. Davom eting, eshityapman.

scenes.title: Tushib qolish va o‘zgarish
board: next week → nex' week · last night → las' night
did you → /ˈdɪdʒu/ · don't you → /ˈdəʊntʃu/
ten pounds → te(m) pounds
scenes.say_native: Ikki undosh orasida “t” va “d” ko‘pincha tushib qoladi: “next week”, “last night”. “D” yoki “t” dan keyin “you” kelsa, ular qo‘shiladi: “did you” “didju”, “don’t you” “dəʊntʃu” bo‘ladi. “N” esa “p” yoki “b” oldidan “m” ga yaqinlashadi: “ten pounds”. Bu xato emas, ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilarning tabiiy talaffuzi.
scenes.say: See you next week. I stayed late last night. Did you get my email? Don't you think it's too expensive? It's only ten pounds.
scenes.say_uz: Kelasi haftada ko‘rishamiz. Kecha kechgacha qoldim. Xatimni oldingizmi? Sizningcha bu juda qimmat emasmi? Atigi o‘n funt.

scenes.title: Og‘zaki qisqarishlar: gonna, wanna…
board: gonna = going to (future) · wanna = want to
gotta = have got to · kinda = kind of
dunno = don't know · lemme = let me · gimme = give me
scenes.say_native: Og‘zaki qisqarishlar: “gonna” bu “going to”, “wanna” bu “want to”, “gotta” bu “have got to”, “kinda” bu “kind of”, “dunno” bu “don’t know”, “lemme” bu “let me”. Ular filmlarda va ofisdagi norasmiy suhbatlarda juda ko‘p uchraydi, siz ularni albatta tanishingiz kerak. Lekin bu og‘zaki nutq: rasmiy xatda yozilmaydi.
scenes.say: I'm gonna call the client. Do you wanna join us for lunch? Sorry, I gotta go. It's kinda complicated. I dunno. Lemme check my calendar.
scenes.say_uz: Mijozga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Biz bilan tushlikka borasizmi? Kechirasiz, ketishim kerak. Bu biroz murakkab. Bilmadim. Kalendarimni tekshirib ko‘ray.

scenes.title: “Gonna” qayerda ishlamaydi
board: ✗ I'm gonna the office. → ✓ I'm going to the office.
✗ We wanna inform you… (email)
✓ We would like to inform you…
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: “gonna” faqat kelasi zamon ma’nosidagi “going to” o‘rnida, undan keyin fe’l turadi. “I’m going to the office” gapida esa “going” harakat, “to” joy, bu yerda “gonna” deyilmaydi. Ikkinchisi: filmdagi “wanna”ni ish xatiga yozish. Rasmiy xatda “We would like to” yozing.
scenes.say: You can say: I'm gonna call her. But you can't say: I'm gonna the office. And in a formal email, write: We would like to inform you.
scenes.say_uz: Aytish mumkin: I'm gonna call her. Lekin I'm gonna the office deb bo‘lmaydi. Rasmiy xatda esa yozing: Sizga ma’lum qilmoqchimiz.

scenes.title: To‘liq shaklini ayting
board: 1 I dunno where it is.
2 Lemme have a look.
3 We gotta leave at six.
4 D'you wanna come?
scenes.say_native: Doskada to‘rtta og‘zaki gap bor. Har birining to‘liq, darslikdagi shaklini baland ovozda ayting yoki daftaringizga yozing. Masalan, “gonna” o‘rniga “going to” deysiz. To‘rtinchi gapga e’tibor bering: unda ikkita qisqarish bor, biri savol boshida.
scenes.say: Here are four natural sentences. Say the full form of each one. I dunno where it is. Lemme have a look. We gotta leave at six. D'you wanna come?
scenes.say_uz: Mana to‘rtta tabiiy gap. Har birining to‘liq shaklini ayting. Qayerdaligini bilmayman. Bir qaray. Oltida ketishimiz kerak. Kelishni xohlaysizmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: to‘liq shakllar
board: 1 I don't know where it is.
2 Let me have a look.
3 We have got to (have to) leave at six.
4 Do you want to come?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “I don’t know where it is.” “Let me have a look.” “We have got to leave at six”, ya’ni “we have to”. “Do you want to come?” Bu yerda “do you” qisqarib “d’you”, “want to” esa “wanna” bo‘ldi. Hammasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, quloqingiz bu shakllarga tayyor.
scenes.say: One: I don't know where it is. Two: Let me have a look. Three: We have got to leave at six. Four: Do you want to come?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Qayerdaligini bilmayman. Ikkinchi: Bir qarab ko‘ray. Uchinchi: Oltida ketishimiz kerak. To‘rtinchi: Kelishni xohlaysizmi?

scenes.title: Can yoki can’t? Eng xavfli juftlik
board: I can come. → /aɪ kən ˈkʌm/ (weak, short)
I can't come. → /aɪ ˈkɑːnt ˈkʌm/ (strong, long)
US: can't /kænt/, final t often very soft
scenes.say_native: Ishda eng qimmatga tushadigan xato: “can” va “can’t”ni adashtirish. Oxirgi “t” tez nutqda deyarli eshitilmaydi. Farq urg‘uda: tasdiqda “can” kuchsiz “kən”, urg‘u keyingi fe’lda. Inkorda “can’t” urg‘uli va uzun: Britaniyada “kɑːnt”, Amerikada “kænt”. Qisqa, yutilgan bo‘g‘in — “can”, aniq urg‘uli bo‘g‘in — “can’t”.
scenes.say: I can join the call. I can't join the call. We can deliver on Monday. We can't deliver on Monday. Listen to the stress, not to the letter t.
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘ng‘iroqqa qo‘shila olaman. Qo‘ng‘iroqqa qo‘shila olmayman. Dushanba yetkazib bera olamiz. Dushanba yetkazib bera olmaymiz. T harfiga emas, urg‘uga quloq soling.

scenes.title: Can yoki can’t — tinglang
board: 1 ... make it on Friday
2 ... join the call at three
3 ... send the invoice today
4 ... sign the contract tomorrow
scenes.say_native: Tinglang. To‘rtta gap aytiladi, har birida “can” yoki “can’t” bor. Daftaringizga bir dan to‘rtgacha raqam yozib, yoniga belgilang. Harfga emas, urg‘uga quloq soling: uzun, urg‘uli bo‘g‘in inkorni bildiradi, qisqa va yutilgan bo‘g‘in esa tasdiqni.
scenes.say: Number one. I can't make it on Friday. Number two. She can join the call at three. Number three. We can't send the invoice today. Number four. They can sign the contract tomorrow.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi. Juma kuni kela olmayman. Ikkinchi. U soat uchda qo‘ng‘iroqqa qo‘shila oladi. Uchinchi. Bugun hisob-fakturani yubora olmaymiz. To‘rtinchi. Ular ertaga shartnomani imzolay oladi.

scenes.title: Javoblar: can va can’t
board: 1 can't  2 can  3 can't  4 can
can't = stressed, long vowel
Not sure? Ask: Sorry, can or can't?

examples.t: Sorry, did you say you can or can't?

scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchisi “can’t”, ikkinchisi “can”, uchinchisi “can’t”, to‘rtinchisi “can”. Haqiqiy suhbatda ishonchingiz komil bo‘lmasa, uyalmasdan qayta so‘rang. Shartnoma, to‘lov yoki muddat haqida gap ketsa, bitta aniqlashtiruvchi savol ko‘p muammodan saqlaydi.
scenes.say: One: can't. Two: can. Three: can't. Four: can. If you are not sure, just check: Sorry, did you say you can or you can't?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: can't. Ikkinchi: can. Uchinchi: can't. To‘rtinchi: can. Ishonchingiz komil bo‘lmasa, tekshiring: Kechirasiz, qila olasiz dedingizmi yoki qila olmaysiz?

scenes.title: To‘ldiruvchi so‘zlar (fillers)
board: um · uh · er/erm (UK) · well · so
like · you know · I mean · sort of / kind of
basically · actually · anyway
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi mavzu: to‘ldiruvchi so‘zlar. Biz “anu”, “haligi”, “xullas”, “ya’ni” deymiz. Inglizlar “um”, “uh”, Britaniyada “er” va “erm”, shuningdek “like”, “you know”, “I mean”, “sort of”, “basically” deydi. Ular gapiruvchiga o‘ylash uchun vaqt beradi. Tinglovchi uchun qoida: ular yangi ma’lumot bermaydi, ularni xayolan o‘chirib, asosiy so‘zlarni ushlang.
scenes.say: Well, um, it's kind of urgent. I mean, the client is, like, waiting for an answer, you know? So, basically, we need the figures today.
scenes.say_uz: Xo‘sh, anu, bu biroz shoshilinch. Ya’ni mijoz, haligi, javob kutyapti, bilasizmi? Xullas, raqamlar bizga bugun kerak.

scenes.title: O‘zini tuzatish: yakuniy javob muhim
board: sorry · I mean · or rather · actually · no, wait
on Tuesday, sorry, Wednesday → Wednesday
So / Anyway → back to the main point
scenes.say_native: Tez nutqda odamlar ko‘pincha o‘zini tuzatadi. Signal so‘zlar: “sorry”, “I mean”, “or rather”, “actually”, “no, wait”. Ulardan keyingi ma’lumot yakuniy. Tinglash imtihonlarida bu klassik tuzoq: avval bitta raqam aytiladi, keyin tuzatiladi. “So” va “anyway” esa gapiruvchi asosiy fikrga qaytayotganini bildiradi.
scenes.say: The meeting is on Tuesday, sorry, Wednesday. It's in room twelve, or rather fourteen. Actually, let's start at nine thirty. Anyway, the main thing is the budget.
scenes.say_uz: Yig‘ilish seshanba, kechirasiz, chorshanba kuni. U o‘n ikkinchi, aniqrog‘i o‘n to‘rtinchi xonada. Aslida, to‘qqiz yarimda boshlaylik. Nima bo‘lganda ham, asosiysi byudjet.

scenes.title: Birinchi dialog: Tomning qo‘ng‘irog‘i
board: Phone call: Tom → Aziz
Topic: the monthly report
Listen for: problem · new deadline · request
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash. Hamkasbi Tom Azizga hisobot haqida qo‘ng‘iroq qilyapti. U ko‘p to‘ldiruvchi so‘z ishlatadi va bir marta o‘zini tuzatadi. Uch narsani ushlang: muammo nima, yangi muddat qachon va Tom nimani so‘rayapti. Har bir “um” va “like”ga e’tibor bermang.
scenes.say: Hi Aziz, it's Tom. So, um, about the monthly report. Basically, we're, like, a bit behind. I mean, the figures from the sales team came in late, you know, so we're gonna need a couple more days. Er, the plan is to send it on Friday. Sorry, not Friday, Monday morning. Anyway, the main thing is, could you check the charts before then? Thanks, mate.
scenes.say_uz: Salom Aziz, men Tom. Xullas, anu, oylik hisobot haqida. Qisqasi, biz biroz orqada qolyapmiz. Ya’ni savdo bo‘limining raqamlari kech keldi, bilasan, shuning uchun yana bir-ikki kun kerak bo‘ladi. Reja uni juma kuni yuborish. Kechirasan, juma emas, dushanba ertalab. Nima bo‘lganda ham, asosiysi, undan oldin diagrammalarni tekshirib bera olasanmi? Rahmat, do‘stim.

scenes.title: Tom nima dedi?
board: 1 Why is the report late?
2 When will they send it?
3 What does Tom ask Aziz to do?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Hisobot nega kechikyapti? Uni qachon yuborishadi? Ehtiyot bo‘ling, bu yerda o‘zini tuzatish bor edi. Tom Azizdan nimani so‘rayapti? Javoblarni qisqa, ingliz tilida ayting. Kalit so‘zlar yetarli, to‘liq gap shart emas, “um” va “like” esa umuman kerak emas.
scenes.say: Answer three questions. Why is the report late? When will they send it? What does Tom ask Aziz to do?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savolga javob bering. Hisobot nega kechikyapti? Uni qachon yuborishadi? Tom Azizdan nima qilishni so‘rayapti?

scenes.title: Javoblar: Tomning qo‘ng‘irog‘i
board: 1 Sales figures came in late.
2 Monday morning (NOT Friday)
3 Check the charts before Monday.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Savdo bo‘limining raqamlari kech kelgan. Yangi muddat dushanba ertalab. Juma desangiz, tuzoqqa tushdingiz: “sorry”dan keyingi ma’lumot yakuniy. Tom dushanbagacha diagrammalarni tekshirishni so‘rayapti, buni “the main thing is” iborasi ko‘rsatib berdi. Gapning yarmi to‘ldiruvchi edi, lekin ma’no to‘liq chiqdi.
scenes.say: One: the sales figures came in late. Two: on Monday morning, not on Friday. Three: he wants Aziz to check the charts before Monday.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: savdo raqamlari kech kelgan. Ikkinchi: dushanba ertalab, juma emas. Uchinchi: u Azizdan dushanbagacha diagrammalarni tekshirishni so‘rayapti.

scenes.title: To‘ldiruvchi so‘zlardagi xatolar
board: ✗ Writing down the first number you hear
✗ “Eee…”, “koroche”, “tak” in English
✓ um · well · let me think · so
scenes.say_native: Tinglashdagi xato: birinchi eshitgan raqam yoki kunni darhol yozib, keyingi tuzatishni eshitmay qolish. Gap tugaguncha kuting. Gapirishdagi xato: o‘zbekcha uzun “eee...” yoki ruscha “koroche”, “tak”, “nu”ni inglizcha nutqqa qo‘shish. Ularning o‘rniga qisqa “um”, “well” yoki “so” ishlating.
scenes.say: Don't write the first number you hear. Wait for the end of the sentence. And when you need time to think, say um, well, or let me think.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi eshitgan raqamingizni yozmang. Gap oxirini kuting. O‘ylash uchun vaqt kerak bo‘lsa, um, well yoki let me think deng.

scenes.title: Vaqt yutish: professional iboralar
board: That's a good question. Let me think.
How can I put it? · Off the top of my head…
I'll check and get back to you.
scenes.say_native: O‘ylash uchun vaqt olish ham san’at. Yig‘ilishda kutilmagan savol berilsa: “That’s a good question. Let me think.” “How can I put it?” — qanday desam ekan. “Off the top of my head” — hozir aniq hisoblamay, taxminan. Oxirida “I’ll check and get back to you”, ya’ni aniqlab, xabar beraman. Bu iboralar sizni ishonchli ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: That's a good question. Let me think. Off the top of my head, I'd say about five thousand dollars, but I'll check and get back to you.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi savol. O‘ylab ko‘ray. Hozir taxminan aytsam, besh ming dollar atrofida, lekin tekshirib, sizga xabar beraman.

scenes.title: Notanish so‘z: to‘xtamang, taxmin qiling
board: 1 What word class? (noun, verb, adjective)
2 Positive or negative?
3 What do the words around it say?
4 Is it important? If not, let it go.
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi mavzu: kontekstdan taxmin qilish. Tinglashda lug‘atga vaqt yo‘q. To‘rt savol bering: bu ot, fe’l yoki sifatmi? Ohang ijobiymi yoki salbiy? Atrofdagi so‘zlar nima deyapti? Bu so‘z vazifa uchun kerakmi? Kerak bo‘lmasa, qo‘yib yuboring. Ko‘pincha keyingi gap ma’noni o‘zi tushuntiradi.
scenes.say: When you hear an unknown word, don't stop. Ask yourself: Is it a noun, a verb or an adjective? Is it positive or negative? What do the other words tell me? Do I really need it?
scenes.say_uz: Notanish so‘zni eshitsangiz, to‘xtamang. O‘zingizdan so‘rang: bu ot, fe’l yoki sifatmi? Ijobiymi yoki salbiy? Boshqa so‘zlar menga nima deyapti? U menga haqiqatan kerakmi?

scenes.title: Kontekst ishoralari
board: Definition: which means / in other words
Example: such as / like / for instance
Contrast: but / although / unlike
Result: so / that's why

examples.t: We're swamped, so I can't take on anything else.
examples.uz: Ishimiz juda ko‘p, shuning uchun boshqa ish ololmayman.

scenes.say_native: Gapiruvchi ko‘pincha ma’noni o‘zi ochib beradi. “Which means”, “in other words”dan keyin izoh keladi, “such as”dan keyin misol. “But”, “unlike” qarama-qarshilikni ko‘rsatadi. “So” natijani beradi: “We’re swamped, so I can’t take on anything else” — natijadan bilamiz, “swamped” ishi juda ko‘p degani.
scenes.say: We're swamped, so I can't take on anything else. The process is very tedious, in other words, slow and boring. The new system is reliable, unlike the old one, which crashed every week.
scenes.say_uz: Ishimiz boshimizdan oshib ketgan, shuning uchun boshqa ish ololmayman. Jarayon juda zerikarli, boshqacha aytganda, sekin va bezovta qiluvchi. Yangi tizim ishonchli, har hafta buzilib qoladigan eskisidan farqli o‘laroq.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi dialog: kofe yonida suhbat
board: Mark & Lola, office kitchen
dragging their feet · swamped
ballpark figure · touch base
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Mark va Lola ofis oshxonasida kofe ichib gaplashyapti. Doskadagi to‘rtta ish iborasini ehtimol bilmaysiz. Lug‘atga qaramang: har biri atrofidagi gaplardan tushuniladi. Tinglang va har bir iboraning ma’nosini taxmin qilishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Mark: Hey Lola, how's the Henderson deal going? Lola: Ugh, don't ask. They've been dragging their feet for weeks. Every time we send the contract, they find a new reason not to sign. Mark: That's annoying. Are you busy this week? Lola: Swamped, honestly. Three deadlines and a training day. Mark: Okay, I won't add more. Can you just give me a ballpark figure for the budget? Lola: Around forty thousand, but don't quote me on that. Let's touch base on Monday.
scenes.say_uz: Mark: Salom Lola, Henderson bitimi qanday ketyapti? Lola: Uh, so‘rama. Ular haftalardan beri cho‘zib kelyapti. Har safar shartnomani yuborsak, imzolamaslik uchun yangi sabab topishadi. Mark: Bu asabga tegadi. Bu hafta bandmisan? Lola: Rostini aytsam, ishim boshimdan oshgan. Uchta muddat va bir o‘quv kuni. Mark: Mayli, boshqa ish qo‘shmayman. Byudjet uchun taxminiy raqam ayta olasanmi? Lola: Qirq ming atrofida, lekin buni aniq deb olma. Dushanba kuni gaplashib olamiz.

scenes.title: Iboralar ma’nosini toping
board: 1 dragging their feet: a) walking slowly b) delaying c) saying no
2 swamped: a) very busy b) tired c) bored
3 ballpark figure: a) exact price b) rough estimate c) final bill
4 touch base: a) meet briefly to update b) sign c) cancel
scenes.say_native: Har bir ibora uchun a, b yoki c ni tanlang. Kontekstni eslang: mijoz imzolamaslik uchun yangi sabab topyapti; Lolaning uchta muddati va o‘quv kuni bor; Mark “just” bilan oddiy raqam so‘radi; dushanba kuni esa ular qisqa uchrashadi. Javoblaringizni ayting.
scenes.say: Choose a, b or c for each expression. Think about the words around it, not the dictionary.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir ibora uchun a, b yoki c ni tanlang. Lug‘at haqida emas, atrofdagi so‘zlar haqida o‘ylang.

scenes.title: Javoblar va kontekst
board: 1 b) delaying · 2 a) very busy
3 b) rough estimate · 4 a) meet briefly to update
don't quote me on that = it's not exact
scenes.say_native: Birinchi b, ataylab kechiktirish; ishora: “a new reason not to sign”. Ikkinchi a, juda band; ishora: uchta muddat. Uchinchi b, taxminiy raqam; ishora: “around forty thousand”. To‘rtinchi a, qisqa gaplashib yangilik almashish. Bonus: “don’t quote me on that” — raqam aniq emas, keyin meni ayblamang degani.
scenes.say: One is b: they keep delaying. Two is a: she's very busy. Three is b: a rough estimate. Four is a: a short meeting to update each other. And don't quote me on that means the number isn't exact.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchisi b: ular kechiktirib kelyapti. Ikkinchisi a: u juda band. Uchinchisi b: taxminiy hisob. To‘rtinchisi a: bir-birini xabardor qilish uchun qisqa uchrashuv. Don't quote me on that esa raqam aniq emasligini bildiradi.

scenes.title: Bitta so‘zga yopishib qolish
board: ✗ Unknown word → panic → miss the next 3 sentences
✗ Translating every word into Uzbek
✓ Keep listening; meaning often comes later
scenes.say_native: Ko‘p uchraydigan xato: notanish so‘z eshitilishi bilan miyada “bu nima degani?” savoli aylanadi, shu paytda keyingi uchta gap o‘tib ketadi. Bitta so‘z uchun butun ma’lumot yo‘qoladi. Ikkinchi xato: har so‘zni ichda o‘zbekchaga tarjima qilish. To‘g‘ri yo‘l: so‘zni xayolan belgilang va tinglashda davom eting.
scenes.say: Don't let one unknown word stop you. Mark it in your mind and keep listening. The next sentence often explains it.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta notanish so‘z sizni to‘xtatib qo‘ymasin. Uni xayolan belgilab, tinglashda davom eting. Keyingi gap ko‘pincha uni tushuntirib beradi.

scenes.title: Tushunmasangiz, xushmuomala so‘rang
board: Sorry, could you say that again?
Could you slow down a little, please?
Did you say fifteen or fifty?
Just to check: you mean …?

examples.t: Just to check, you mean Monday the third?
examples.uz: Aniqlashtirib olay, dushanba, uchinchi sanani nazarda tutyapsizmi?

scenes.say_native: Ishda tinglash imtihondan farq qiladi: qayta so‘rash mumkin. “Could you say that again?”, “Could you slow down a little?”, “Did you say fifteen or fifty?”, “Just to check, you mean...?” Bizda qayta so‘rash ba’zan noqulay tuyuladi, inglizcha ish muhitida esa bu mas’uliyat belgisi.
scenes.say: Sorry, could you say that again? Could you slow down a little, please? Did you say fifteen or fifty? Just to check, you mean the meeting is on Monday the third?
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, buni qaytara olasizmi? Iltimos, biroz sekinroq gapira olasizmi? O‘n besh dedingizmi yoki ellik? Aniqlashtirib olay, yig‘ilish dushanba, uchinchi sanadami?

scenes.title: Fifteen yoki fifty?
board: fif-TEEN /ˌfɪfˈtiːn/ → long /iːn/
FIF-ty /ˈfɪfti/ → short /i/
US: fifty ≈ “fifdy” (soft t)
scenes.say_native: Raqamlar tez nutqning eng xavfli joyi. “-teen” raqamlarida urg‘u odatda ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda va unli uzun: “fif-TEEN”. “-ty” raqamlarida urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, oxiri qisqa: “FIF-ty”. Amerika talaffuzida “-ty”dagi “t” yumshab, “d”ga o‘xshaydi. Uzun “iːn” eshitsangiz, bu “-teen”.
scenes.say: Thirteen, thirty. Fourteen, forty. Fifteen, fifty. Sixteen, sixty. The room holds fifteen people. The room holds fifty people.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n uch, o‘ttiz. O‘n to‘rt, qirq. O‘n besh, ellik. O‘n olti, oltmish. Xonaga o‘n besh kishi sig‘adi. Xonaga ellik kishi sig‘adi.

scenes.title: Raqamni yozib oling
board: 1 The room holds ... people.
2 The ticket costs ... pounds.
3 Please print ... copies.
4 The train leaves at six ...
scenes.say_native: Tinglang va to‘rtta raqamni daftaringizga yozing. Har birida “-teen” yoki “-ty” bor. Urg‘u qaysi bo‘g‘inda ekaniga va oxirgi unli uzun yoki qisqaligiga quloq soling. Raqamni so‘z bilan emas, darhol raqam bilan yozing, vaqtni esa nuqta bilan.
scenes.say: Number one. The room holds fifteen people. Number two. The ticket costs forty pounds. Number three. Please print seventy copies. Number four. The train leaves at six eighteen.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi. Xonaga o‘n besh kishi sig‘adi. Ikkinchi. Chipta qirq funt turadi. Uchinchi. Iltimos, yetmish nusxa chop eting. To‘rtinchi. Poyezd oltidan o‘n sakkiz daqiqa o‘tganda jo‘naydi.

scenes.title: Javoblar: raqamlar
board: -teen: long /iːn/ · -ty: short /i/
Numbers in writing: always use digits in notes
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: o‘n besh, qirq, yetmish va olti o‘n sakkiz. To‘rttasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, ajoyib. Bitta xato bo‘lsa, o‘sha juftlikni ovoz chiqarib bir necha marta ayting: “fifteen, fifty”. Qayd yozayotganda raqamlarni hech qachon so‘z bilan yozmang: 15, 40, 70. Bu tezroq va adashmaysiz.
scenes.say: Fifteen. Forty. Seventy. Six eighteen. When you take notes, always write numbers as digits. It's faster and clearer.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n besh. Qirq. Yetmish. Olti o‘n sakkiz. Yozib olayotganda raqamlarni har doim raqam bilan yozing. Bu tezroq va aniqroq.

scenes.title: Kalit so‘zlar: urg‘u ma’noni olib keladi
board: Content words = stressed: nouns, main verbs, adjectives, numbers, not
Function words = weak: a, the, to, of, is, can
The DELIVERY will be LATE on FRIDAY.

examples.t: The delivery will be late on Friday.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi mavzu: kalit so‘zlar. Ma’noni olib keladigan so‘zlar urg‘uli aytiladi: otlar, asosiy fe’llar, sifatlar, raqamlar va inkor. O‘zbek tilida bo‘g‘inlar nisbatan bir tekis aytiladi, ingliz tilida esa urg‘uli so‘zlar baland va uzun. Faqat ularni ushlasangiz ham, xabar tushunarli: “delivery, late, Friday”.
scenes.say: The delivery will be late on Friday. We need to change the date of the meeting. The client didn't like the new design.
scenes.say_uz: Yetkazib berish juma kuni kechikadi. Yig‘ilish sanasini o‘zgartirishimiz kerak. Mijozga yangi dizayn yoqmadi.

scenes.title: Tinglashdan oldin bashorat qiling
board: Who? → a name  · When? → day, date, time
How much / How many? → a number
What's the problem? → late, broken, missing…
scenes.say_native: Kalit so‘zni ushlash uchun nimani kutayotganingizni biling. “Who” — ism kutasiz. “When” — kun, sana, vaqt. “How much” — narx yoki raqam. Muammo bo‘lsa — “late”, “cancelled”, “missing” kabi so‘zlar. Bu bashorat quloqni yo‘naltiradi: butun oqimni emas, kerakli ilgaklarni tutasiz.
scenes.say: Before you listen, predict. Who? Listen for a name. When? Listen for a day, a date or a time. How much? Listen for a number. What's the problem? Listen for words like late, cancelled or missing.
scenes.say_uz: Tinglashdan oldin bashorat qiling. Kim? Ismga quloq soling. Qachon? Kun, sana yoki vaqtga. Qancha? Raqamga. Muammo nima? Kechikdi, bekor qilindi yoki yo‘qoldi kabi so‘zlarga.

scenes.title: Uchinchi dialog: ovozli xabar
board: Voicemail from a supplier
Who? · Order number? · Problem?
New date? · What should you do?
scenes.say_native: Haqiqiy ish vaziyati: yetkazib beruvchi kompaniyadan ovozli xabar. Xabar tez, unda to‘ldiruvchilar, qisqarishlar va bitta tuzatish bor. Doskadagi savollarni oldindan o‘qing va bashorat qiling: ism, raqam, muammo, sana, harakat. Qalamni tayyorlang.
scenes.say: Hi, this is, er, Dan Cooper from Brightline Logistics. I'm calling about your order, number four seven two nine. Um, so, unfortunately, the delivery's gonna be late. There's been a problem at the port, kinda out of our hands. We're now expecting it on the fourteenth, sorry, the fifteenth of March. If that's a problem, just give us a ring on oh two oh, seven nine four six, double five one two. Thanks, bye.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, men, anu, Brightline Logistics kompaniyasidan Den Kuper. Buyurtmangiz yuzasidan qo‘ng‘iroq qilyapman, raqami to‘rt yetti ikki to‘qqiz. Xullas, afsuski, yetkazib berish kechikadi. Portda muammo chiqdi, bu biroz bizning qo‘limizda emas. Endi uni o‘n to‘rtinchi, kechirasiz, o‘n beshinchi martda kutyapmiz. Agar bu muammo bo‘lsa, bizga nol ikki nol, yetti to‘qqiz to‘rt olti, besh besh bir ikki raqamiga qo‘ng‘iroq qiling. Rahmat, xayr.

scenes.title: Xabardan qayd yozing
board: Caller: ...  Company: ...
Order no.: ...  Problem: ...
New date: ...  Phone: ...
scenes.say_native: Rahbaringiz uchun qisqa qayd yozing. Faqat kalit so‘zlar va raqamlar: kim, qaysi kompaniyadan, buyurtma raqami, muammo, yangi sana va telefon. Britaniyada telefon raqamidagi “oh” nol, “double five” esa ikki marta besh ekanini unutmang. To‘liq gap yozmang.
scenes.say: Write a short note. Who called? From which company? What is the order number? What's the problem? What's the new date? What's the phone number?
scenes.say_uz: Qisqa qayd yozing. Kim qo‘ng‘iroq qildi? Qaysi kompaniyadan? Buyurtma raqami qanday? Muammo nima? Yangi sana qachon? Telefon raqami qanday?

scenes.title: Javoblar: ovozli xabar
board: Dan Cooper, Brightline Logistics · Order 4729
Late: problem at the port · New date: 15 March
Call 020 7946 5512 if it's a problem
scenes.say_native: Tekshiramiz. Den Kuper, Brightline Logistics. Buyurtma 4729. Muammo portda, shuning uchun yetkazish kechikadi. Yangi sana 15-mart, 14 emas, chunki “sorry”dan keyin tuzatish bor. Telefon: 020 7946 5512. “Kinda out of our hands” esa “bu bizga bog‘liq emas” degani.
scenes.say: Dan Cooper from Brightline Logistics. Order four seven two nine. There's a problem at the port, so the delivery will be late. The new date is the fifteenth of March. Call oh two oh, seven nine four six, five five one two.
scenes.say_uz: Brightline Logistics kompaniyasidan Den Kuper. Buyurtma to‘rt yetti ikki to‘qqiz. Portda muammo bor, shuning uchun yetkazish kechikadi. Yangi sana o‘n beshinchi mart. Nol ikki nol, yetti to‘qqiz to‘rt olti, besh besh bir ikki raqamiga qo‘ng‘iroq qiling.

scenes.title: Hammasini yozishga urinmang
board: ✗ Writing every word (dictation)
✓ Notes: names, numbers, problem, action
✓ Use symbols: → (so), ✗ (cancelled), ↑ (more)
scenes.say_native: Ko‘p o‘quvchi xabarni diktant kabi so‘zma-so‘z yozishga urinadi va uchinchi gapdayoq orqada qoladi. Qayd boshqacha: ism, raqam, muammo va harakat. Belgilardan foydalaning: strelka “shuning uchun”, iks “bekor qilindi”. Qisqa, aniq qayd uzun, chala diktantdan ancha qimmatli.
scenes.say: Don't try to write every word. Write names, numbers, the problem and the action. Use symbols and short forms to save time.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir so‘zni yozishga urinmang. Ismlar, raqamlar, muammo va harakatni yozing. Vaqt tejash uchun belgilar va qisqartmalardan foydalaning.

scenes.title: To‘rtinchi dialog: tezkor yig‘ilish
board: Daily stand-up meeting
Nodira (manager) · Sam (developer) · Priya (designer)
Listen for: test day · users want · send results
scenes.say_native: Oxirgi dialog: IT kompaniyadagi kundalik qisqa yig‘ilish, “stand-up meeting”. Nodira rahbar, Sam dasturchi, Priya dizayner. Hamma narsa birga: qisqarishlar, to‘ldiruvchilar, tuzatish va kalit so‘zlar. Test kuni, foydalanuvchilar istagi va natijalar vaqtini ushlang.
scenes.say: Nodira: Okay, let's make it quick. Sam, what's the update? Sam: Yeah, so, the app's kinda ready. We just gotta fix a couple of bugs. Nodira: When can we test it? Sam: Er, Wednesday? Actually, let's say Thursday, to be safe. Nodira: Fine. Priya? Priya: I've finished the user survey. Basically, people love the design, but they want a dark mode. Nodira: Great. Can you send me the results? Priya: Sure, I'll send them over after lunch.
scenes.say_uz: Nodira: Xo‘p, tez o‘taylik. Sem, qanday yangilik? Sem: Ha, xullas, ilova deyarli tayyor. Faqat bir-ikkita xatoni tuzatishimiz kerak. Nodira: Uni qachon test qila olamiz? Sem: Chorshanba? Aslida, ishonchli bo‘lishi uchun payshanba deylik. Nodira: Mayli. Priya? Priya: Foydalanuvchilar so‘rovnomasini tugatdim. Qisqasi, odamlarga dizayn juda yoqdi, lekin ular tungi rejimni xohlashyapti. Nodira: Ajoyib. Natijalarni menga yubora olasanmi? Priya: Albatta, tushlikdan keyin yuboraman.

scenes.title: Yig‘ilish bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1 What does Sam still need to do?
2 When can they test the app?
3 What do users want?
4 When will Priya send the results?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Sem hali nima qilishi kerak? Ilovani qachon test qilishadi? Bu yerda ham tuzoq bor edi, shuning uchun oxirgi variantni eslang. Foydalanuvchilar nimani xohlashyapti? Priya natijalarni qachon yuboradi? Javoblarni qisqa, kalit so‘zlar bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Four questions. What does Sam still need to do? When can they test the app? What do users want? When will Priya send the results?
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta savol. Sem hali nima qilishi kerak? Ilovani qachon test qilishlari mumkin? Foydalanuvchilar nima xohlaydi? Priya natijalarni qachon yuboradi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: yig‘ilish
board: 1 Fix a couple of bugs (gotta = have got to)
2 Thursday (NOT Wednesday: actually…)
3 A dark mode  4 After lunch
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Sem bir-ikkita xatoni, ya’ni “bugs”ni tuzatishi kerak; “gotta” majburiyatni bildirdi. Test payshanba kuni: Sem avval chorshanba dedi, keyin “actually” bilan o‘zgartirdi. Foydalanuvchilar tungi rejim xohlaydi, bu “but”dan keyin keldi. Priya tushlikdan keyin yuboradi.
scenes.say: One: he's got to fix a couple of bugs. Two: on Thursday, not Wednesday. Three: they want a dark mode. Four: after lunch.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: u bir-ikkita xatoni tuzatishi kerak. Ikkinchi: payshanba, chorshanba emas. Uchinchi: ular tungi rejimni xohlaydi. To‘rtinchi: tushlikdan keyin.

scenes.title: Quloqni mashq qildirish: shadowing
board: Shadowing = repeat 1 second behind the speaker
I'm gonna have to get back to you on that.
Did you get a chance to look at it? (didju · ge-tə)
Let's touch base next week. (nex' week)
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz orqali tinglashni kuchaytiramiz. Usul nomi “shadowing”, ya’ni soya bo‘lish: gapiruvchidan bir soniya orqada uning ohangi va ulanishlarini nusxalab takrorlaysiz. Doskadagi uch gapni sinab ko‘ring: “to” kuchsiz “tə”, “did you” birikib “didju”, “next week”da “t” tushadi. O‘zingiz shunday gapirsangiz, eshitish ham osonlashadi. Kuniga bir-ikki daqiqa yetarli.
scenes.say: Repeat after me, just behind my voice. I'm gonna have to get back to you on that. Did you get a chance to look at it? Let's touch base next week.
scenes.say_uz: Ovozimdan sal keyin takrorlang. Bu borada sizga keyinroq javob berishimga to‘g‘ri keladi. Unga qarab chiqishga imkoningiz bo‘ldimi? Kelasi hafta gaplashib olamiz.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: rahbarga yetkazing
board: Retell Dan's voicemail to your manager
3 sentences: who + problem → new date → action
Start: Dan from Brightline called…
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa. Denning ovozli xabarini rahbaringizga uch gapda yetkazing: kim qo‘ng‘iroq qildi va muammo nima, yangi sana, endi nima qilish kerak. To‘ldiruvchilarni va tuzatilgan ma’lumotni olib tashlang, faqat yakuniy faktlarni ayting. Baland ovozda gapiring.
scenes.say: Retell Dan's voicemail to your manager in three sentences. Who called and what's the problem? What's the new date? What should you do next?
scenes.say_uz: Denning ovozli xabarini rahbaringizga uch gapda aytib bering. Kim qo‘ng‘iroq qildi va muammo nima? Yangi sana qachon? Keyin nima qilish kerak?

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: Dan from Brightline called: order 4729 will be late
because of a problem at the port. It should arrive on 15 March.
If that doesn't work for us, we should call him back.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javobni tinglang. E’tibor bering: unda hech qanday “um” yoki “kinda” yo‘q, noto‘g‘ri sana ham yo‘q. Siz eshitgan tez, tartibsiz nutqni qisqa, aniq xabarga aylantirdingiz. Ishda aynan shu ko‘nikma qadrlanadi: tinglash, filtrlash va yetkazish.
scenes.say: Dan from Brightline called. Our order will be late because of a problem at the port. It should now arrive on the fifteenth of March, and if that's a problem, we should call him back.
scenes.say_uz: Brightline’dan Den qo‘ng‘iroq qildi. Buyurtmamiz portdagi muammo sababli kechikadi. Endi u o‘n beshinchi martda kelishi kerak, agar bu muammo bo‘lsa, unga qayta qo‘ng‘iroq qilishimiz kerak.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Sounds: weak forms, linking, gonna/wanna, can vs can't
Fillers: ignore them; after sorry/actually = final info
Context: word class, tone, clues · Key words: stressed, predict, note
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Tez nutqda kichik so‘zlar kuchsizlanadi, so‘zlar ulanadi, “t” va “d” tushadi, “gonna” kabi qisqarishlar bor; “can’t”ni urg‘usidan taniymiz. To‘ldiruvchilarni filtrlaymiz, “sorry” va “actually”dan keyingi ma’lumot yakuniy. Notanish so‘zni kontekstdan taxmin qilamiz. Urg‘uli kalit so‘zlarni bashorat qilib, qisqa qayd yozamiz.
scenes.say: Small words become weak, and words link together. Ignore the fillers and listen for corrections. Guess new words from context. Predict, catch the stressed key words and take short notes.
scenes.say_uz: Kichik so‘zlar kuchsizlanadi, so‘zlar bir-biriga ulanadi. To‘ldiruvchilarga e’tibor bermang va tuzatishlarga quloq soling. Yangi so‘zlarni kontekstdan taxmin qiling. Bashorat qiling, urg‘uli kalit so‘zlarni ushlang va qisqa qayd yozing.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: transcribe 1 minute of natural speech
(interview, vlog, podcast with real conversation)
Success: 80% of content words + mark weak forms
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: tabiiy nutqdan bir daqiqalik parcha tanlang: intervyu, vlog yoki suhbat podkasti. Uni to‘xtatib-to‘xtatib yozib chiqing, keyin subtitr bilan solishtiring va kuchsiz shakllar hamda ulanishlarni belgilang. Mezon: ma’noli so‘zlarning kamida 80 foizi to‘g‘ri. Keyingi darsda yangiliklar va podkastlarni tushunishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to transcribe one minute of natural speech, then check it and mark the weak forms and linking. Next time we will learn to follow the news and podcasts.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: bir daqiqalik tabiiy nutqni yozib chiqish, keyin uni tekshirib, kuchsiz shakllar va ulanishlarni belgilash. Keyingi safar yangiliklar va podkastlarni tushunishni o‘rganamiz.

homework_uz: Tabiiy nutqdan bir daqiqalik parcha tanlang (intervyu, vlog yoki suhbat podkasti; o‘qib berilgan matn emas) va uni to‘xtatib-to‘xtatib so‘zma-so‘z yozib chiqing. So‘ng subtitr yoki transkript bilan solishtiring, “gonna”, “wanna”, kuchsiz “to/for/of” va ulangan so‘zlarni belgilang, eshitolmagan joylaringiz sababini yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: ma’noli so‘zlarning (ot, fe’l, sifat, raqam) kamida 80 foizi to‘g‘ri yozilgan bo‘lsin. Keyingi darsda yangiliklar va podkastlarni tushunishni o‘rganamiz.

quiz.q: In natural speech, how is "to" usually pronounced in "I want to go"?
quiz.why_uz: Urg‘usiz grammatik so‘zlar kuchsiz shaklda aytiladi: to → /tə/.
Gonna = going to + fe’l, faqat kelasi zamon ma’nosida: We're gonna call you.

quiz.q: How can you usually hear the difference between "can" and "can't"?
options: "Can't" is stressed and has a longer vowel
quiz.why_uz: Oxirgi t ko‘pincha eshitilmaydi; can’t urg‘uli va unlisi uzun, can esa kuchsiz /kən/.

quiz.q: "The meeting is on Tuesday, sorry, Wednesday." When is the meeting?
quiz.why_uz: “Sorry”dan keyingi ma’lumot tuzatilgan, yakuniy javob: Wednesday.

quiz.q: What is the main job of fillers like "um", "you know" and "I mean"?
options: To give the speaker time to think
quiz.why_uz: To‘ldiruvchi so‘zlar o‘ylash uchun vaqt beradi, yangi ma’lumot olib kelmaydi.

quiz.q: "We're swamped, so I can't take on anything else." What does "swamped" mean?
quiz.why_uz: “So I can’t take on anything else” natijasi “swamped” juda band degani ekanini ko‘rsatadi.

quiz.q: Which number has the stress on the FIRST syllable?
quiz.why_uz: -ty raqamlarida urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: FIF-ty; -teen raqamlarida odatda ikkinchisida.

quiz.q: Which words are usually stressed and carry the key information?
quiz.why_uz: Ma’noli so‘zlar (ot, asosiy fe’l, sifat, raqam) urg‘uli aytiladi va asosiy ma’noni beradi.

quiz.q: You didn't catch a price on the phone. What is the best thing to say?
options: Sorry, did you say fifteen or fifty?
quiz.why_uz: Xushmuomala va aniq qayta so‘rash: Sorry, did you say fifteen or fifty?

quiz.q: When you take notes from a voicemail, what should you write?
options: Names, numbers, the problem and the action
quiz.why_uz: Qaydda faqat kalit ma’lumot: ism, raqam, muammo va kerakli harakat yoziladi.
